summary: The proof correctly establishes positivity of the defect parameter, identifies the global minimum delta as zero on the entire ratio prism, and then uses the largest-gap-specific refinement of accepted fact 6aa12d1b76699246 to obtain the stronger local lower bound D >= 9/152. The numerical bounds on A_k, c_k, d_0, d_{1k}, d_{2k}, and tau are valid for k in {2,3}, and the resulting inequality D > tau_def contradicts the strict defect bridge from accepted fact 0009896ebff12f31. The truncation and continuity argument covers coincident endpoint strata while preserving the strict gap-chamber condition in the limit.
